title: Wrong database password after a deploy
reason: Diagnosis correctly identifies the API component, the missing password as a config issue, and the deployment of version 2.3.2 as the trigger.
root_cause: The API container was redeployed to version 2.3.2 with an incorrect or missing database password environment variable, causing PostgreSQL authentication failures that the web frontend shows as 'Service unavailable' on product pages.
truth: api 2.3.2 reads the database password from a new setting that was never filled in, so PostgreSQL rejects every login from the api.
